name: Britax Click & Go Infant Car Seat Adapter (Maxi-Cosi / Cybex / Nuna)
seatBrandsSupported: Maxi-Cosi (Mico 30 / Max 30 / AP / Prezi) / Cybex (Aton, Aton 2/Q, Cloud Q) / Nuna (Pipa, Pipa Lite). The Clek Liing/Liingo share the Maxi-Cosi footprint — Clek's official list names the Britax 'Click'n Go Infant Car Seat Adapter' as the adapter for the B-Lively, so the Liing fits via this bracket. Retailer pages list Maxi-Cosi/Cybex/Nuna (not 'Clek' by name).
_priceNote: Mega Babies $59.99 (sold out at check); Amazon listing carries the 2-count set — reconfirm live price.

install.notes: Britax Click & Go bracket system; the infant seat clicks onto the adapters mounted on the B-Lively frame. Fits B-Lively / B-Agile / B-Free / B-Ready / Pathway single strollers.

notes: Britax's Maxi-Cosi/Cybex/Nuna Click & Go adapter (part S05824400) is what Clek's list calls the B-Lively 'Click'n Go' adapter. Clek Liing shares the Maxi-Cosi footprint so it attaches. ~$59.99; availability spotty. Note Britax also sells a Willow/Cypress-specific adapter and a B-Lively DOUBLE adapter — this single Maxi-Cosi/Nuna/Cybex version is the one for the single B-Lively + Clek Liing.
